candidates.review_note: Place weights five and four in the smallest fitting capacities. For weight three prioritize capacity three, then five, then four to preserve the maximum number of two-slots. Remaining twos need available floor(capacity/2) slots; ones use residual total space.
Aggregate parallel directed capacities, repeatedly augment along residual BFS paths, and update both forward and reverse capacities. Integer arithmetic preserves flows above 32-bit limits.
Hungarian primal-dual augmenting paths find a complete minimum-cost assignment. Applying the same method to negated benefits yields the maximum without changing the one-person/one-job constraint.

Expand the product into subsets of boxes receiving counted increments. For j distinct boxes the expected product of their increment counts is the falling factorial (K)_j divided by N^j; polynomial coefficients of product(A_i+x) supply the remaining initial factors.

DP records the set of contest types already used and the final type. Selecting the current contest either extends its existing final block or starts its only block from a state where that type has never appeared; skipping keeps the old count.
A valid name matches one ASCII uppercase letter followed only by lowercase letters, excluding embedded digits. Sentence-ending punctuation closes and resets the per-sentence count.
Reflect paths at the first prefix with white-minus-black equal to K+1. Subtract the reflected binomial count from all arrangements, rejecting endpoints already beyond the allowed bound.
Read the actual first character without stripping whitespace and test the least significant bit of its ASCII byte.

A maximal product uses threes except that remainder one becomes two twos. Compute the exact bounded integer and print its digit count and leading 100 digits, allowing the documented up-to-5000-digit output internally.
Parse the complete parenthesized grammar across whitespace and lines, distinguishing empty subtrees from zero-valued nodes. Accept only sums at real leaves, never an empty tree or an internal prefix.

Each empty run permits alternating students, with at most one extra seat for one type. Give that possible extra seat to the type with the larger remaining supply and cap each allocation by actual availability.
Maintain only each factor sign in a segment tree. Multiplication combines signs exactly, including zeros, while point changes and range products remain logarithmic and cannot overflow.

Moving to a teleport costs the smaller coordinate difference. Connecting adjacent teleport points in each coordinate sort preserves all such shortest paths; multi-source Dijkstra starts with direct entry costs and adds Manhattan walking cost to the home.

Each segment stores counts of the three residues. Incrementing rotates these counts and composes a modulo-three lazy tag; range queries return the zero-residue count after propagating pending rotations.
